method: SHA-256 verified existing official checkpoints loaded on CPU in existing server containers; sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()); no inference, training, install, container start, or checkpoint modification.

definitions.parameter_elements: All scalar nn.Parameter elements, including biases and frozen parameters; distinct from trainable-as-saved flags.
definitions.fp16_parameter_bytes: 2 × parameter_elements, excluding buffers, activations, runtime workspace and metadata.
definitions.fp32_parameter_bytes: 4 × parameter_elements; theoretical storage if all registered parameters are float32.
definitions.ram: These counts do not measure process RAM or GPU peak memory.
